name: HuoShuCheng
source:
A visual novel where the portrayal of the spirit is gradually dragged into the abnormal, with a rather dark atmosphere.

[Translated from the [url=https://rpg.blue/thread-497827-1-1.html]Project 1[/url]]
translation:
這部視覺小說描繪了人的精神如何一步步被拖入異常狀態，氛圍頗為黑暗。
